params.name: NumIn
comment: / Data width of the payload in bits. Not needed if `DataType` is overwritten.

params.name: DataWidth
comment: / Data type of the payload, can be overwritten with custom type. Only use of `DataWidth`.

params.name: DataType
comment: / The `ExtPrio` option allows to override the internal round robin counter via the
/ `rr_i` signal. This can be useful in case multiple arbiters need to have
/ rotating priorities that are operating in lock-step. If static priority arbitration
/ is needed, just connect `rr_i` to '0.
/ Set to 1'b1 to enable.

params.name: ExtPrio
comment: / If `AxiVldRdy` is set, the req/gnt signals are compliant with the AXI style vld/rdy
/ handshake. Namely, upstream vld (req) must not depend on rdy (gnt), as it can be deasserted
/ again even though vld is asserted. Enabling `AxiVldRdy` leads to a reduction of arbiter
/ delay and area.
/ Set to `1'b1` to treat req/gnt as vld/rdy.

params.name: AxiVldRdy
comment: / The `LockIn` option prevents the arbiter from changing the arbitration
/ decision when the arbiter is disabled. I.e., the index of the first request
/ that wins the arbitration will be locked in case the destination is not
/ able to grant the request in the same cycle.
/ Set to `1'b1` to enable.

params.name: LockIn
comment: / When set, ensures that throughput gets distributed evenly between all inputs.
/ Set to `1'b0` to disable.

params.name: FairArb
comment: / Dependent parameter, do **not** overwrite.
/ Width of the arbitration priority signal and the arbitrated index.

params.name: IdxWidth
comment: / Dependent parameter, do **not** overwrite.
/ Type for defining the arbitration priority and arbitrated index signal.

ports.name: clk_i
comment: / Asynchronous reset, active low.

ports.name: rst_ni
comment: / Clears the arbiter state. Only used if `ExtPrio` is `1'b0` or `LockIn` is `1'b1`.

ports.name: flush_i
comment: / External round-robin priority. Only used if `ExtPrio` is `1'b1.`

ports.name: rr_i
comment: / Input requests arbitration.

ports.name: req_i
comment: verilator lint_off UNOPTFLAT
/ Input request is granted.

ports.name: gnt_o
comment: verilator lint_on UNOPTFLAT
/ Input data for arbitration.

ports.name: data_i
comment: / Output request is valid.

ports.name: req_o
comment: / Output request is granted.

ports.name: gnt_i
comment: / Output data.

ports.name: data_o
comment: / Index from which input the data came from.
